name: safespace-mcp
description: The AI safety gateway for an agent's external surface — a provider-agnostic safety envelope between an AI agent and any source it touches. 111 tools across Google Workspace (the flagship connector), GitHub read (repos/issues/PRs/commits/file content + PR diffs — every field sanitize-wrapped) + write (the 2nd OAuth source; writes behind a default-deny repo allowlist + outbound sanitize), Notion read (search/pages/blocks/databases — every title/block/property sanitize-wrapped), a keyless SSRF-gated web_fetch + a default-deny path-gated fs_read, and LINE + Telegram + Discord push. Tier-based tool exposure (read|write|share), tokens behind a SecretBackend (Keychain / encrypted file), MCP-layer untrusted-content tagging, full audit trail.
